---
name: Docs or maintenance task
about: Propose docs cleanup or repository maintenance work
title: "docs: "
labels: ["documentation"]
assignees: []
---

## Summary
One-line description of the task.

## Problem
What is outdated, unclear, or missing.

## Proposed approach
What should be changed and where.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Scope is clear and limited.
- [ ] Docs/process text is accurate after the change.
- [ ] Any referenced paths or commands were checked.

## Relevant docs/files
List docs pages, config files, or workflow files to update.

## Validation expectations
- [ ] Confirm links and paths still resolve.
- [ ] If workflow/config changed, confirm YAML/TOML parses.
- [ ] Note any manual checks done.

If this is repo upkeep without docs focus, switch the label to `maintenance` (and add `infra`/`ci`/`dependencies` when useful).
Need label help? See `docs/ISSUE_LABELS.md`.
